exposure: Gestational age at delivery (early term vs. full term)
outcome: Neonatal intensive care unit length of stay
Need for supplemental oxygen at day 30 of life
cohort: 185 pregnant women with prenatally diagnosed isolated CDH cases, delivering between July 1, 2008, and December 31, 2018
finding: No significant differences in neonatal outcomes were found between early-term and full-term deliveries for CDH neonates, although a trend towards improved survival in the full-term group was observed.
mod_finding: While mode of delivery did not significantly impact survival to hospital discharge, 5-minute Apgar scores were higher in the elective cesarean and induced vaginal delivery groups compared to spontaneous vaginal and unplanned cesarean groups.
gest_age: Early term (37-38 weeks 6 days) vs. full term (39-40 weeks 6 days)
followup_time: 30 days of life (for supplemental oxygen need)
